<!-- pr-reviewer: e44df8e2876c428c2a15711677489d247e3986e7 -->
Needs changes before merge. The Face change is clean. The family order blocks the PR: #3353 must merge first, and then this branch must take `origin/main` and be checked again.

This is an independent re-review of head `e44df8e28`. The earlier `merge-ready` comment came from the author, so it is not an independent review (AGENTS.md, "Only collaborators' reviews count"). This review was built locally; no runner run.

## What looks good

- The Face row is a display only. `no_pass_order_row` holds the combo at Auto and disables it (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/pass_start_row.rs:43`). The reason is a visible `consequence` line, not hover text.
- The text is true for Face. Face cuts serpentine rows from `x_in` to `x_out` at each Y (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/face.rs:182`). The first and last rows stand at the face edges, so there is no inside or outside order.
- MCP refuses `pass_start` on a Face by name, for every word including `auto` (`crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs:67`). The refusal is in `patched`, so `add_operation` gets it too. The pin confirms that a refused patch changes nothing.
- No refusal or safety rule is lost. The Face change adds one refusal and moves no toolpath. No golden and no snapshot PNG changes.
- Process: the body has `Process change: yes` for `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`. The PR does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.
- The body has a `Changelog:` row and ends with `Fixes #3356`. The commit subjects are conventional. The decision file follows `docs/decisions/README.md`.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` is added outside tests. The added sites in `crates/geometry/src/geo2d/clip_line.rs` are all inside its `#[cfg(test)]` module.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_page.rs` was already over 400 lines (405 on main). This change adds 5 lines to it. This is a flag, not a blocker.

## Results, merged with main `bcc712b30` (local build)

The trial merge with `bcc712b30` was clean. Git auto-merged 5 files and stopped before committing. I ran the steps that the review law names (AGENTS.md, "Heavy lanes at review").

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main --dry-run`: the diff (40 files) falls back to the batch tier, because `crates/geometry/src/geo2d.rs` is a shared crate. I ran the touched steps by name, not the whole batch.
- motion `pass_start_levels`: 5 passed, 0 failed.
- app `face_pass_start`: 1 passed, 0 failed. It is `mcp_refuses_pass_start_on_face_by_the_row_order`.
- app `offset_pass_start`: 3 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored (the heavy fig8 pins).
- app `example_catalog`: 37 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored.
- app `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed, 0 failed.
- app `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` from `crates/ui`: 1,441 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored. It includes `egui_app::tests::pass_start::the_face_passes_tab_says_it_has_no_pass_order`.
- clippy, `-p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: pass.
- light lane: `motion light: lib` ok. `motion light: adaptive_troch_parallel` ok (release, 7.1 min).

Heavy lanes: not run. A `P2` PR gets no heavy step (#3556). The full heavy lanes run at the cut.

## Requested before merge

1. Merge #3353 first. This branch is stacked on it. The branch carries parent `9939a6238`, and it does not include #3353's later head `3c3f13eb4`. That later commit makes the guard fallback post `StrategyFallback`. After #3353 merges, @mkinney merges `origin/main` into this branch, pushes, and asks for a re-check.

## Questions / notes

- The body says "The PR stays a draft." The PR is ready. Please correct that line.
- `add_operation` with `pass_start` on a Face is refused by the same check, but no pin covers that path. One small pin would cover it.
- The body reports 1,432 UI tests. I read 1,441 on the merged tree, because main has new tests. This is not a defect.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 765fefe37cbda07975f33a906a6671e3763c04fc -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge. Set `merge-ready`.

This is a re-check of head `765fefe37`. The merge is class SAME, so the review at `e44df8e28` carries.

## What I verified

- Head `765fefe37` has two parents: `e44df8e28` (the reviewed head) and `5346bd7ac` (`origin/main`). The branch takes a plain merge. It has no rebase and no force-push.
- `git show --remerge-diff 765fefe37` is empty. The merge has no hand edit.
- `cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 3387 --reviewed e44df8e28` says: "SAME: only merges of the base with no hand edits: the tree is what merging the reviewed head would give - the review stands, no agent needed".
- GitHub reports `MERGEABLE` and `CLEAN`.
- The body has no stale draft line.

## Readings on the refreshed head (from the re-check comment)

- Motion `pass_start_levels`: 7 passed, 0 failed.
- App `face_pass_start`: 1 passed, 0 failed.
- App `offset_pass_start`: 4 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored (the heavy fig8 pins).
- Clippy on `camcraft-geometry`, `camcraft-motion`, `camcraft-app` and `camcraft-ui`, `--all-targets -- -D warnings`: pass.

I did not run the suites again. Class SAME changes no source, so the review at `e44df8e28` and its readings stand (AGENTS.md, "A clean merge of main keeps its review").

Heavy lanes: not run. A `P2` PR gets no heavy step (#3556). The full heavy lanes run at the cut.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
